en: Monochrome panoramic view of a Central European town on a river, with a multi-span bridge crossing the water into a dense old town with church spires and low mountains in the background. The front caption reads "Gruss aus Marburg a. D." The reverse is a classic Austro‑Hungarian "Korrespondenz‑Karte" with a 5‑value stamp and a circular postmark reading "LAIBACH," plus handwritten address text.
